package_004l.name: Controlled General-Ledger Posting and Accounting Export Evidence
package_004l.governing_rule: journals are source-derived and balanced; corrections and export corrections are additive

package_004m.name: Controlled Accounting Periods and Close Governance
package_004m.status: implemented on PR #35 pending exact documentation-synchronised release gate
invariants: financial years do not overlap within a tenant
accounting periods do not overlap and are contained within one financial year
journal posting and journal reversal require an accounting date in exactly one configured open period
accounting export must exactly match one configured soft-closed or hard-closed period
hard close requires active export evidence for every journal in the period
hard-closed export evidence cannot be reversed until the period is explicitly reopened
period status transitions are additive evidence with member, reason and timestamp
period governance constrains new accounting evidence and never rewrites operational events or posted journals
deliberate_exclusions: year-end closing journals and retained-earnings transfer

validation.generated_kysely_drift: zero across core + collections + accounting outputs
validation.status: exact documentation-synchronised Package 004M head must reproduce the complete gate before merge

next_boundary.name: Controlled Trial Balance and Financial Reporting
recommended_sequence: derive trial balance from immutable active accounting journals by accounting period
prove debit/credit equality and opening/current/closing balances

make reporting respect period status and reversal evidence
keep statutory filing, consolidation, bank reconciliation, AP expansion and FX as later boundaries
next_boundary.governing_rule: financial reporting must be a derivation over governed journal evidence; reports must never become a second editable ledger
